subject: general
question: In May 2025, which state/union territory government approved five cloud-seeding trials at an outlay of ₹3.21 crore to combat air pollution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Delhi government** approved five cloud-seeding trials in **May 2025** to combat the severe issue of **air pollution**, specifically smog and particulate matter.
 
• An amount of **₹3.21 crore** was allocated for these trials, showcasing a significant step toward implementing scientific methods to tackle environmental issues.
 
• **Cloud seeding** is a weather modification technique that involves dispersing substances like **silver iodide** or **potassium iodide** into the atmosphere to induce rainfall. This helps in reducing airborne pollutants by bringing them to the ground.
 
• The initiative was taken in response to worsening air quality in Delhi, which has consistently ranked as one of the most polluted cities globally according to the **World Air Quality Index**.
 
• This effort aligns with the broader environmental goals of the **National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi** to improve public health and mitigate the adverse impacts of pollution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **What is Cloud Seeding?**

 
 
• Cloud seeding is a form of **weather modification** where chemicals like **silver iodide**, **potassium iodide**, or dry ice are dispersed into clouds to encourage precipitation.
 
• The method is used globally for purposes like **rain enhancement**, **snowpack augmentation**, and **hail suppression**.
 
• It helps in **reducing air pollution** by washing down particulate matter and other pollutants from the atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **Air Pollution in Delhi:**
 
 
• Delhi faces severe air pollution due to factors like **vehicular emissions**, **industrial activities**, **construction dust**, and **stubble burning** in nearby states.
 
• During winter, the pollution levels worsen due to the formation of **smog**, which is a mixture of smoke and fog.
 
• The **Air Quality Index (AQI)** often crosses hazardous levels, causing respiratory and cardiovascular health issues.
 
 
 
• **Alternative Measures Taken by the Delhi Government:**
 
 
• Implementation of the **Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP)** to tackle pollution during high-risk periods.
 
• Promotion of **electric vehicles (EVs)** under the **Delhi EV Policy**.
 
• Introduction of the **Odd-Even Traffic Scheme** to reduce vehicular emissions.
 
• Deployment of air purifiers and **anti-smog guns** at construction sites.
 
 
 
• **Global Examples of Cloud Seeding:**
 
 
• The **United Arab Emirates** uses cloud seeding to enhance rainfall in its arid climate.
 
• **China** deployed extensive cloud seeding programs during the **2008 Beijing Olympics** to ensure clear skies.
 
• The **United States** uses cloud seeding in states like **Colorado** and **Wyoming** to increase snowpack for water resources.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Effectiveness of Cloud Seeding:** While cloud seeding is a promising solution, its effectiveness depends on the availability of suitable clouds and specific atmospheric conditions.
 
• **Health Impacts of Air Pollution:** Long-term exposure to pollutants like PM2.5 and PM10 can lead to **respiratory diseases**, **cardiovascular problems**, and reduced life expectancy.
 
• **International Support:** Many countries, including **Germany** and **Japan**, are collaborating with India to share expertise and technology for pollution control.
 
• **Public Awareness Campaigns:** The Delhi government also conducts campaigns to educate the public about pollution control measures and the importance of sustainable practices.
